create_Act_with_relu: create an Act module with relu activation and apply it to a PyTorch tensor
create_Act_with_leaky_sp: create an Act module with leaky_sp activation and custom slope for a tensor
create_Act_with_ssp: create an Act module with shifted softplus activation and forward pass on input
create_Act_with_leaky_tanh: create an Act module with leaky_tanh activation and apply it to a tensor
create_Act_with_swish: create an Act module with swish activation and compute forward pass on data
